decisions.rationale: The span joins two separate disease mentions with 'with': recurrent meningococcal meningitis and the absence of the sixth complement component (C6 deficiency). Contiguous strings referring to two diseases are annotated as one Composite Mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 2 (Contiguous text strings / Composite Mention)

decisions.rationale: The span joins two separate diseases with 'and': recurrent meningococcal meningitis and absence of the sixth complement component (C6 deficiency). It is therefore a Composite Mention rather than a single Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 2 (Contiguous text strings / Composite Mention)

decisions.rationale: 'C6' is the abbreviation of the sixth complement component, a protein, in the parenthetical definition. It does not name a disease on its own; the disease is 'C6 deficiency', which is annotated separately.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease) and 6 (Synonymous mentions); What NOT to Annotate 4 (general terms)

decisions.rationale: 'Recurrent neisserial infections' refers to a family of infections caused by Neisseria (meningococcal meningitis, gonococcal infection), not one specific disease. The disease is clearly discussed, so it is annotated as a Disease Class.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Disease Class); What NOT to Annotate 1 (organism names unless the disease is clearly discussed)

decisions.rationale: 'C6 deficiency' is a single, well-defined inherited complement deficiency with no further categorization needed, so it is a Specific Disease.
'C6-deficient' is a disease name used adjectivally to modify the noun 'serum'. It is therefore annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (Modifiers for other concepts)

decisions.rationale: This is a duplicate mention of 'recurrent neisserial infections' in the same abstract. Duplicates are annotated separately, and the phrase is a family of Neisseria infections, so it is a Disease Class.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 4 (Duplicate mentions) and 1 (Disease Class)

decisions.rationale: 'Absence of one of the late-acting complement components' describes a family of deficiencies (e.g., C5 to C9 deficiencies), not one specific disease. It is therefore a Disease Class, though it is a grey-area phrase.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Disease Class) and grey-area guidance (Examples 11)
